brief_answer: For monitoring glucose and lactate in a cell culture aqueous medium, Raman spectroscopy is recommended as the primary method due to its low water interference. A single-probe Raman setup forms the simplest test option, while NIR or combined approaches can be compared if turbidity and biomass tracking are required. Feasibility trials with representative samples and reference lab data are the necessary next step.
